body:
## Scope · Confidential legal intake (public coordination metadata only)

Classification: CONFIDENTIAL_SOURCE_MATERIAL_OFF_REPOSITORY.
An administrative project/work-unit index, not a source-code candidate, runtime effect or EAP/EMP acknowledgment.

### Purpose
Track an owner-directed legal-document intake, prior-source correlation, preservation and counsel handoff as a separate workstream of the authority repository.
**Security boundary:** The public repository must not contain original scans, personally identifying case files, attorney-client communications or new unsubstantiated allegations against identifiable people. Those remain in a separate confidential dossier for the owner.

### Previously published source
- Existing first-person narrative: https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/blob/main/docs/Die_Spirale_des_entscheidenden_Unterschieds.md . Treat this as a SELF_REPORT, not independently verified proof.
- Current repository work-intake/governance: https://github.com/ingolf-lohmann/qik-vrt/issues/758 . Dynamically discover subsequent related work; do not hardcode an execution candidate.

### Verified private intake metadata (no case identifiers)
- Two JPEG images of a two-page document, provided by the owner in this conversation on 2026-11-19, preserved bit-for-bit unchanged.
- Page 1 SHA-256: bdf95e93d921e6f4fa94d90be31441e6c5151646ebd04325730a821c0029b87a.
- Page 2 SHA-256: 3e7d18652b64d8689c91a59cffc65ea3a480d6e83bd0c4b93bf748ae006f0840.
- Private local dossier assembled: provenance metadata, legal-source reading, evidence matrix, timeline reconciliation questions, attorney email draft, original photo copies and checksum manifest. **These files are not stored in the public repository or mirrored.**

### Workstream and acceptance
- [x] Preserve source bytes, compute digest, record a source inventory.
- [x] Find and compare the earlier published account, preserving epistemic distinctions.
- [x] Verify counsel address, prepare an unsent email draft with the two source photographs.
- [ ] Confirm actual counsel handoff, attachment acceptance and mandate.
- [ ] Verify actual receipt date, procedural deadlines and authorized representation.
- [ ] Obtain competent case-file access and assess originating complaint, witness accounts, documentary evidence.
- [ ] Build a source-timestamped chronology, check whether locations and persons coincide, investigate independent corroboration and alternative explanations.
- [ ] Separately assess relevance of earlier administrative events; avoid assuming coordination or causality.
- [ ] Close only upon counsel-reviewed conclusion and readback; no unsupported effect acknowledgment.

State: COUNSEL_DRAFT_PREPARED / UNSENT / CASE_FILE_NOT_OBTAINED / VERIFICATION_CONTINUES.
No repository source mutation, no CI re-trigger, no new execution controller.
